description: Direction Départementale des Territoires du Doubs: landslide and ground movement hazard datasets is a collection of datasets listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Direction Départementale des Territoires du Doubs. Coverage: Direction Départementale des Territoires du Doubs. The listing groups 7 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about landslide and ground movement hazard; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Mouvements de terrain de type effondrement hors Plan de Prévention des; Mouvements de terrain de type éboulement hors Plan de Prévention des R; Mouvements de terrain de type glissements hors Plan de Prévention des ; Zone réglementée du Plan de Prévention des Risques Mouvement de Terrai. Formats seen: SHP, ODT, ZIP. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
